objective: Turn the production winery planner dataset into a canonical, citation-ready research asset that can earn editorial links, press citations, AI retrieval, and qualified referral traffic.
searchTargets: Old Mission vs Leelanau winery data
qualityRules: All headline counts derive from the production dataset rather than duplicated page constants.
Grape counts use only records with source URL, source label, and verification date.
Directory inclusion is explicitly separated from wine-trail association membership.
Geographic measures are labeled straight-line, not road miles.
Machine-readable downloads are noindex and point users back to the canonical research page.
The research page is linked from the homepage, publisher kit, and peninsula comparison.
Chris Izworski remains the canonical creator in Dataset and Article schema.
